blocks.title: Evaluation
blocks.body: Screen market tier, urban context, capital envelope, and whether Radisson RED's lifestyle select-service promise matches the physical asset and operator—not whether it merely needs a Radisson logo. Confirm Choice development interest, flex F&B feasibility, and social-scene operating capacity before committing conversion capital or relying on loyalty contribution assumptions.

blocks.title: Conversion Design
blocks.body: Shape conversion design around RED prototype—OUIBar + KTCHN scope, digiwall lobby, guestroom boldness, and fitness—while meeting Choice systems requirements. Align PIP, FF&E, and operator capacity with intended social activation; avoid treating RED as a cosmetic reflag that leaves public-space gaps unfunded.

blocks.title: Pre-Opening
blocks.body: Sequence hiring, RED and Choice training, PMS/CRS/loyalty cutover, and soft-opening plans with design sign-off. Budget time for social programming setup and QA touchpoints. Third-party operators typically lead daily pre-opening execution while owners fund capital and confirm milestone approvals with brand development.

blocks.title: Opening
blocks.body: Execute opening with rate integrity, channel mix discipline, and early QA focus across the first 90–120 days. Guest-facing teams should deliver RED social energy and service consistency while Choice systems stabilize. Confirm who owns commercial launch versus brand QA in the specific agreement.

blocks.title: Ramp-Up
blocks.body: During ramp-up, calibrate loyalty contribution, seasonal urban retail, and lobby programming against guest feedback and labor tied to flex F&B—not only occupancy headlines. Revisit capital residuals, staffing plans, and social-space upkeep carefully before committing any year-one repositioning spend.

blocks.title: Ongoing
blocks.body: On an ongoing basis, maintain capex planning, brand initiatives, and portfolio benchmarks inside Choice reporting and QA rhythms. Reassess operator fit and competitive set when urban markets shift—RED value depends on sustained social presentation plus reliable system participation.
